WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT
    m.Name AS media_type_name,
    AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
), overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT
  r.media_type_name,
  r.rate,
  r.track_count,
  r.rate - o.mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean
FROM media_type_rates AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
WHERE r.rate > o.mean_rate;
